## Source

::: {.callout-note}
Note: The Office of the Medical Examiner is required to investigate deaths that occur in Orange County so these data include non-residents. These data do not include residents that died of an overdose outside of Orange County. These data include: accidental, suicide, and undetermined manner of death; and primary and secondary causes of death included are acute drug intoxication, acute mixed drug intoxication, and acute intoxication. When calculating rates, the 2023 5-Year American Community Survey from the US Census Bureau were used.
:::
